  PROBLEM: The runtime copy chains the default and base fetches with `;` and omits the safeguard requiring each fetch to run separately with its exit status checked.
  WHY: A failed default fetch can leave a stale remote-tracking ref, causing the drift check to pass and the session to proceed with an outdated guard.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` runtime copy must receive the "Run each fetch as its own Bash call" text via `[claude-twin-sync]` (twin-first; interim until #4785). Commit b3b924d edited only the `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` twin, `tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py`, and the progress log.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`, step 1 of the Claude-asset sync
  Evidence of absence: Reading `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:181` shows `git fetch origin <default>`; for a PR head also `git fetch origin <base>` with the `;`-joined phrasing and no "Run each fetch as its own Bash call" safeguard. `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:181` has the fix: `, and for a PR head also` plus "Run each fetch as its own Bash call and read its exit status: chained with `;` the exit status is the last command's, so a failed first fetch would go unnoticed." The progress log at `docs/implement-plan/issue-5260-asset-sync-pr-base-drift.md` documents twin sync as needed with sha256 values. Copilot review comment 4150903024 on `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:181` independently reports the same gap. This is the known, expected state under the interim twin-first default.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Evidence of absence: The PR body lists AD-1 through AD-7. The progress log `docs/implement-plan/issue-5260-asset-sync-pr-base-drift.md:47` records AD-8 ("The log reads `Status: COMPLETE` while final PR #5280 is still open: resume at verify-activation or re-arm the final-merge wait? — Picked: A — re-arm the final-merge wait on #5280."). === FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:181 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The runtime copy chains the fetches with `;`, unlike the template twin, which requires separate Bash calls and checking each exit status.
  WHY: If the default fetch fails, a stale ref can make the drift check report the branch as fresh and allow work to proceed with the older guard.
- tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py: `test_twins_are_byte_identical` at lines 33-35 (parametrized over `["fix-claude-pr.md", "implement-plan-claude.md"]`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_twins_are_byte_identical` fails because only the template twin was updated, leaving the runtime and template copies of `implement-plan-claude.md` different.
  WHY: The test compares both files' bytes, but the runtime copy lacks the template's fetch safeguard.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The project contract requires every auto-decision to be surfaced in the in-flight PR body for review, so update the PR's **Auto-decisions** section to include AD-8 before approval." (CLAUDE.md §28.D requires each auto-decision to ride the PR in flight under `## Auto-decisions` in the PR body, listed in the same entries under the PR body's `## Auto-decisions` subsection.)
  Expected change site: PR #5280 body, `## Auto-decisions (pending review)` section, between the existing AD-7 bullet and any closing line.
  Evidence of absence: The PR body inlined in the UNTRUSTED PR INTENT CONTEXT block lists exactly seven entries (AD-1 through AD-7) and ends its `## Auto-decisions` list with "AD-7: the conformance stage resumed a stale `IN_PROGRESS` log instead of stopping". AD-8 ("[final-merge — review wait, 2026-09-30] The log reads `Status: COMPLETE` (set by the completion PR) while final PR #5280 is still open: resume at verify-activation or re-arm the final-merge wait? — Picked: A — re-arm the final-merge wait on #5280.") appears only in the progress log at `docs/implement-plan/issue-5260-asset-sync-pr-base-drift.md` (under `## Auto-decisions`) and was added by commit b3b924d, but is absent from the PR description's `## Auto-decisions` list. No diff hunk updates the PR body to include AD-8. The Copilot inline review comment 4150903048 on `docs/implement-plan/issue-5260-asset-sync-pr-base-drift.md:49` independently reports the same gap. Reviewers reading only the PR body cannot review AD-8, violating the project contract.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Line 181; compare with workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:181 and tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py:33-35. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The runtime copy omits the instruction to run each fetch in a separate Bash call. Its step still presents the fetches separated by `;`, while the template explicitly warns that this can hide a failed first fetch. The copies also differ, violating the byte-identical test.
  WHY: If a session runs both fetches in one Bash call, a failed default-branch fetch followed by a successful base fetch returns the latter’s status. The default drift check can then read the stale `origin/<default>` and proceed without syncing its guard changes. The twin parity test also fails for these divergent files.
